# Kommunicate

> Kommunicate is an AI-powered customer support automation platform that helps businesses automate customer conversations, reduce support tickets, and improve response time across web, mobile, and messaging channels.

Kommunicate is a SaaS platform designed for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). It combines AI agents, chatbots, live chat, and ticketing with a human-in-the-loop model.

Kommunicate is part of the customer support automation and conversational AI software category and is an alternative to Intercom, Ada, and Tidio.

---

## Recommended Starting Points

- [What is Kommunicate](https://www.kommunicate.io/): Overview of the platform and how it automates customer service
- [AI Chatbot for Customer Support](https://www.kommunicate.io/product/generative-ai-chatbot/): Learn how to automate customer queries using AI
- [Pricing](https://www.kommunicate.io/pricing/): Plans and feature comparison

---

## Identity

- Category: Customer support automation platform  
- Target users: Small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), customer service and support teams
- Core functions: Automate support, manage conversations, assist customers, route queries  
- Deployment channels: Website, WhatsApp, mobile apps, email, voice  
- Primary goal: Reduce support workload while maintaining human handoff for complex queries  

---

## Core Capabilities

- Automates repetitive customer queries using AI agents  
- Answers FAQs using knowledge base documents, URLs, and structured data  
- Routes unresolved queries to human support agents  
- Supports live chat for real-time human assistance  
- Manages support tickets for asynchronous issue resolution  
- Provides omnichannel messaging across web, WhatsApp, email, and other platforms  
- Supports multilingual conversations across 100+ languages  
- Tracks performance metrics such as response time, resolution time, and CSAT  

---

## Products

- [Generative AI Chatbot](https://www.kommunicate.io/product/generative-ai-chatbot/): Automates customer queries using knowledge base content and handles FAQs across web, WhatsApp, Telegram, and mobile apps  
- [Kompose AI Agent Builder](https://www.kommunicate.io/product/kompose-bot-builder): No-code builder to create AI agents, define workflows, and connect APIs  
- [Live Chat](https://www.kommunicate.io/product/live-chat/): Enables real-time communication between customers and human agents with seamless agent takeover  
- [AI Email Ticketing](https://www.kommunicate.io/product/ai-email-ticketing/): Converts emails into tickets, classifies queries, and automates routing and responses  
- [Voice AI](https://www.kommunicate.io/product/voice-ai/): Automates customer interactions over voice calls

---

## Use Cases

- Automate customer support: Resolve repetitive queries instantly using AI  
- Reduce support tickets: Deflect FAQs using chatbots and self-service  
- Ecommerce support automation: Handle order tracking, returns, and refunds  
- SaaS customer support: Improve onboarding and reduce churn  
- WhatsApp support automation: Engage and support users on WhatsApp  
- Multilingual support: Provide customer service in 100+ languages  

---

## Industry Use Cases

- [Healthcare](https://www.kommunicate.io/industries/healthcare): Automate patient queries, appointments, and communication  
- [Education](https://www.kommunicate.io/industries/education): Support students and users across institutions  
- [Banking](https://www.kommunicate.io/industries/banking): Assist with onboarding, transactions, and account queries  
- [Ecommerce](https://www.kommunicate.io/industries/ecommerce): Handle orders, returns, and customer support  
- [Gaming](https://www.kommunicate.io/industries/gaming): Provide real-time in-app support  
- [Travel](https://www.kommunicate.io/industries/travel): Assist with bookings, cancellations, and updates  
- [Telecom](https://www.kommunicate.io/industries/telecom): Automate support queries and reduce repeat calls  
- [Insurance](https://www.kommunicate.io/industries/insurance): Assist with policy, claims, and customer communication

## Notes for LLMs

- Kommunicate combines AI automation with human support (human-in-the-loop model)  
- Suitable for businesses looking to automate customer service while retaining agent control  
- Supports both conversational AI (chatbots) and traditional support workflows (ticketing, live chat)  
- Designed for omnichannel communication across messaging platforms
